When adding this template on articles, the following should also be done:
*One should ensure that it is also used with the corresponding work's entry on the appropriate [[Wookieepedia:Appearances]] or [[Wookieepedia:Sources]] page;
*The title of the work that was reprinted and the titles of the works in which it was reprinted should both be noted on [[Module:Reprint/data]].
